maddeler.e:
أنتقع (form VIII)
# أَنْتَقِعُ (ʔantaqiʕu) /ʔan.ta.qi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# أُنْتَقَعُ (ʔuntaqaʕu) /ʔun.ta.qa.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# أَنْتَقِعَ (ʔantaqiʕa) /ʔan.ta.qi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# أُنْتَقَعَ (ʔuntaqaʕa) /ʔun.ta.qa
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
